title: Take / took / taken
descriptionFa: take برای زمان، بردن چیزی با خودت، وسیله‌ی نقلیه، و کلاس و دوره.

words.example: I took my camera on holiday.
It takes me twenty minutes to walk to work.
words.tipFa: it + take + آدم + زمان: It took me two hours yesterday.

words.example: How long does it take to get to the airport?
words.tipFa: گذشته: How long did it take you?

words.example: It's going to rain. Take an umbrella with you.
words.tipFa: take = از اینجا به اونجا بردن. بیاری اینجا: bring.

words.example: I want to take a course in photography.
My daughter wants to take lessons in piano.
words.tipFa: have lessons هم همینه. با اسم ساز یا درس: take piano lessons.

words.example: I take the bus to university every day.
words.tipFa: take the train / the underground / the metro هم همین‌طور.

words.example: It's late. Let's take a taxi home.
words.tipFa: با a: take a taxi، ولی take the bus.

words.example: We usually take the train to Mashhad.
